criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Music Playback
categories.definition: User wants to play audio content such as songs, albums, artists, genres, or from a specific platform.

categories.name: Music Playlist Management
categories.definition: User wants to add or manage items within a music playlist or album.

categories.name: Content Rating
categories.definition: User wants to assign a rating or review to a creative work such as a book, movie, album, essay, or series.

categories.name: Restaurant Reservation
categories.definition: User wants to book a table or make a reservation at an eating establishment like a restaurant, bar, or gastropub.

categories.name: Weather Information
categories.definition: User wants to retrieve current weather conditions or a forecast for a specific location, time, or weather attribute.

categories.name: Movie TV Show Showtimes
categories.definition: User wants to find out the schedule or playing times for movies or TV shows at a cinema or venue.

categories.name: Movie TV Show Playback
categories.definition: User wants to watch or stream a specific movie or TV show, or find where it can be watched.

categories.name: Content Search
categories.definition: User wants to find information about or locate a specific creative work such as a book, game, painting, movie title, TV show title, trailer, or saga, without the intent to play it, watch it, or get showtimes.
